quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation.condition: U-turn upon curve or approach to/near grade crest

judgment_calls_needed.note: No invented distance defines near; retain source geometry and pose.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: near the crest of a grade

judgment_calls_needed.note: Virtual eye rays are physical proxies; driver recognition is unresolved.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: cannot be seen by the driver

obligation.description: Vehicle shall not be turned to proceed opposite direction in the stated visibility circumstance

timing.description: at the turn and approaches from either direction
